# Pixel Library Desk

A tiny offline library desk app built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- 6 built-in books with Available / Checked out status
- Check out and return buttons for each book
- Filter to show only available books
- Live count of checked-out books
- Keyboard accessible: all controls are focusable and labeled
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- No network requests, imports, packages, or external assets

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use Tab to move between controls, Enter or Space to activate buttons or toggle the filter.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup
- `styles.css` — styling
- `script.js` — app logic
